description: This PHP source file defines the class pSpring used for drawing spring graphs, including node and link management, layout algorithms, and rendering methods.
external_files: pChart web site (for documentation and license details)

classes.name: pSpring
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and rendering spring graphs with nodes, links, positions, and layout algorithms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the pSpring object with default node styles, link settings, and labels.

methods.name: setLinkDefaults
methods.description: Sets default color and alpha for links between nodes.

methods.name: setLabelsSettings
methods.description: Configures label display options such as type and color for node labels.

methods.name: autoFreeZone
methods.description: Automatically computes the 'FreeZone' radius for each node based on its connections.

methods.name: linkProperties
methods.description: Defines visual properties (colors, name, ticks) for a link between two nodes.

methods.name: setNodeDefaults
methods.description: Sets default style attributes for nodes, including color, shape, and size.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Adds a new node with specified settings, including color, shape, size, and connections.

methods.name: setNodesColor
methods.description: Changes color attributes of one or multiple nodes.

methods.name: dumpNodes
methods.description: Returns the internal data structure containing all node information.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection exists between two nodes, adds it if not present.

methods.name: getMedianOffset
methods.description: Calculates the median position of a node's connected neighbors.

methods.name: getBiggestPartner
methods.description: Finds the connected node with the greatest weight for a given node.

methods.name: firstPass
methods.description: Initial layout computation based on selected algorithm, setting node positions.

methods.name: doPass
methods.description: Performs one iteration of force calculations to adjust node positions.

methods.name: lastPass
methods.description: Final adjustment, resolves collisions, and prepares link drawing data; returns conflict count.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the entire graph within the drawing area.

methods.name: drawSpring
methods.description: Renders the entire graph: links, nodes, labels, optional vectors, and quiet zones.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Returns the angle of the line between two points relative to the X-axis.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Determines if two line segments intersect.
